messages:
maya: Opening a small PR to update a few tool-calling examples to the new "envelope" structured-output shape. PR #4218. Will touch order-cancel, calendar-invite, and embeddings-rerank samples.

rachel: Thanks Maya. Can you confirm the envelope key name? Last meeting mentioned 'envelope' vs 'payload'.

maya: We're standardizing on 'envelope' with subkeys 'result' and optional 'meta'/'error'. Minimal example: {"envelope": {"result": {...}}}. Will add full JSON Schema file under docs/schemas/structured-output.json.

sam: I'll convert the calendar-invite example. Which file path?

maya: docs/examples/flows/calendar-invite.md. Also update docs/guides/tool-calling.md to reference the new schema and sample.

kevin: For SDK side I'll add parse helpers (js + py) showing robust parsing + schema validation. Proposed JS helper snippet: 
```js
function safeParse(text) {
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) {
    const m = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
    return m ? JSON.parse(m[0]) : null;
  }
}
```
Include a short note recommending AJV/schema validation after parse.

rachel: Include a "before/after" diff for each changed snippet in the PR description so docs-bot doesn't block.

maya: Will do. Also note: embeddings example is duplicated in two places (embeddings/usage.md and sdk/examples/embeddings.md). I'll update both and add a redirect for the old anchor.

legal-bot: ATTENTION: The embeddings snippet references external code — please add attribution and confirm compatibility with MIT. Legal will review the PR once attributed.

sam: I'll add an attribution comment in the snippet header and ping legal.

kevin: Can we add two smoke tests in docs-tests that render the example LLM outputs and assert our schema validator accepts them? That should catch formatting regressions.

maya: Yes, adding tests now. They run in the docs CI preview pipeline.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs style requires short migration blurb in docs/migration/tool-calls.md and deploy preview created for PRs touching examples.

maya: Added the migration blurb and the checklist to PR #4218: (1) schema file; (2) examples updated; (3) SDK helpers; (4) tests; (5) redirects; (6) legal attribution.

rachel: Perfect. I'll batch-review after CI completes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — pushing final fixes now.
